text:
Maria CSM: Kickoff for TerraHealth onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and surface any renewal risks up front. Meeting Thursday 10am PT?
Jordan (AM): Thursday works for me. Who from TerraHealth will join?
TerraHealth PM: I can make Thurs 10. I'll bring our Eng lead (Raj) and Security (Ana).
Maria CSM: Great — agenda draft: 1) success metrics for pilot, 2) SSO & data retention, 3) production activation checklist, 4) enablement/training plan, 5) renewal signals & risk flags.
Sam Eng: From infra side I'd like to confirm expected QPS, model size, and any IP restrictions. Can you drop expected traffic numbers here before Thurs?
TerraHealth PM: Planning 2-5 req/s average during pilot, bursts up to ~20 req/s. Models are standard open weights, no IP blocks.
Lee SE: For enablement, we'll want 1) dev sandbox credentials, 2) runbook for common errors, 3) a 60-min developer workshop during week 2 of the pilot.
Jordan (AM): Success criteria I suggest: a) prod latency under 300ms p95 for 95% of calls, b) <1% error rate, c) 2 customer-facing flows validated by TerraHealth PM. If any of these fail after week 2, we classify as "at-risk" for renewal.
Maria CSM: Agree. Let's capture these as measurable checks in the success doc. Also call out data residency + KMS requirements from legal.
TerraHealth PM: Legal flagged KMS + audit logs — Ana will send the spec.
Sam Eng: Noted. I'll spin up a dedicated sandbox pool with tokenized access and enable KV prefix cache. PS: can we get a service account with prod-mint role scoped to the pilot namespace?
Maria CSM: I'll request the service account via onboarding checklist and paste the request template in this thread.
Maria CSM: Request template:
```
Service account name: terra-pilot-svc
Scopes: inference:invoke, metrics:read
Expiry: 90d (extendable)
```
Jordan (AM): Quick ask: what's the renewal checkpoint? If pilot meets success criteria at 30 days, do we auto-escalate to procurement?
Maria CSM: Renewal checkpoint = 45 days post-prod activation. If metrics meet targets and they signal ROI, AM will trigger procurement enablement. If not, we'll open a remediation plan and tag as renewal-risk.
Lee SE: For training materials, I'll draft a 20-slide deck + 3 hands-on lab exercises. Want to record the workshop for their internal team.
TerraHealth PM: Sounds good. Can we have the workshop week of Oct 20?
Maria CSM: I'll confirm calendar after we lock Thurs meeting.
Sam Eng: FYI deploy-bot will run a canary deploy Tue 9pm PT to validate the same model build we'll use in pilot. I'll post logs here after run.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: build 202-tera-01 -> 3 workers, canary 10% traffic. Watch logs: https://deploys.example/202-tera-01
Maria CSM: Thanks — action items before Thurs: 1) TerraHealth to send KMS/audit spec (Ana), 2) TerraTraffic numbers (PM), 3) Sam to confirm sandbox pool sizes, 4) Lee to draft training outline, 5) Maria to share success criteria doc.
Jordan (AM): :thumbsup: I'll prep the procurement checklist and bring it to the meeting.
Maria CSM: Perfect. I'll post the meeting invite + link to the collaborative doc here in the morning.
TerraHealth PM: Appreciate it — looking forward.
Sam Eng: One more note — if we hit sustained >15 req/s we may need temporary burst capacity (reserved GPU) for short windows. Flagging as potential cost/risk item.
Maria CSM: Noted, will capture as risk with estimated cost.
Jordan (AM): Thanks team. See you Thurs. :calendar:
thread_text: Kickoff thread for TerraHealth onboarding — stakeholder alignment, success criteria, timeline, enablement, and renewal risk capture.
